objective: Determine which token-coordinate families inside the common exact signed exchange triangle are structurally necessary for the scalar dependency image, using exhaustive family-subset deletion before scalar replay.

frozenCarrier.pairOrientation: lexicographic endpoint orientation inherited from EW-RS-069

tokenFamilies.C: all role-capacity-parity tokens C:i, retaining exact canonical role index i
tokenFamilies.D0: all owner-0 exact-depth histogram tokens D0:d, retaining exact depth d
tokenFamilies.D1: all owner-1 exact-depth histogram tokens D1:d, retaining exact depth d

encodings.name: SIGN
encodings.definition: For each nonzero exact delta coordinate, retain token identity and sign; discard magnitude.

encodings.name: SIGNED_PARITY
encodings.definition: Retain token identity and sign only when exact delta magnitude is odd; omit every even-magnitude delta coordinate.

structuralProcedure: For every OOO triple, reconstruct the same three WIDTH_CAPMASK_OWNER_DEPTH_HISTOGRAMS vertices used by EW-RS-069/070.
For each pair encoding and each frozen family subset, compute all three pair signatures, deleting token terms whose family is outside the subset.
Sort the three pair signatures to form the triple key.
Map EW-RS-065 matched dependencies to GF(2) parity of triple keys and freeze the structural basis.
Only after every structural candidate map and basis is frozen replay scalar dependency residues.

selectionAndMss.primaryQuestion: Which inclusion-minimal family subsets are scalar-exact on all three carriers under SIGN?
selectionAndMss.secondaryQuestion: Which inclusion-minimal family subsets are scalar-exact on all three carriers under SIGNED_PARITY?
selectionAndMss.noForcedTotalOrder: Report all incomparable minimal exact subsets; do not force a single winner when the subset lattice has multiple minima.

measurements: kernel dimension relative to the corresponding full SIGN or SIGNED_PARITY control
scalar image dimension on structurally selected basis
inclusion-minimal exact subsets per carrier and common across all carriers
antiCircularity: Both pair encodings, all four token families, all 15 family subsets, and the subset valuation are frozen before scalar inspection.
No individual W/C:i/D0:d/D1:d token coordinate is selected or deleted using W/D/L.
Exact role and exact depth indices remain intact within any included family.
EW-RS-065 dependencies and EW-RS-069 vertex/pair orientation are unchanged.
EW-RS-059 PRIMARY 3x6-k4 and BACKUP 5x3-k4 remain sealed.
falsifiers: The full W+C+D0+D1 SIGN subset must reproduce RS-070 ranks 70,283,16 with zero contradictions.
The full W+C+D0+D1 SIGNED_PARITY subset must reproduce RS-070 ranks 73,282,14 with zero contradictions.
Any candidate with zero structural residue and nonzero scalar residue is insufficient.
No outcome-driven family exception or token-level rescue is allowed.
nextIfStrictSubsetPasses: Freeze the inclusion-minimal common family support and next compress role/depth indices within only those retained families.
nextIfAllFamiliesRequired: Retain all four families and move to outcome-independent circuit/basis reduction inside the full signed exchange image rather than deleting individual token coordinates.
interpretationGuards: Family-subset sufficiency is bounded Q-V evidence on the declared hard carriers.
A retained token family is not proved universally necessary unless every strict family subset is structurally ruled out in the declared lattice.
No Q-A/Q-F, standard-7x6, universal theorem, or center-opening proof follows.
